label: trackingIsEmRelative: tracking reaches the layout as points, not thousandths of an em
lineHeightClamps: a line height outside 0.5...4 is kept as given
lastLineNotJustified: the box width is dropped, so a justified paragraph neither wraps nor spans the box
replace: paragraph: ParagraphStyle(alignment: paragraph.alignment, lineHeight: paragraph.lineHeight, tracking: paragraph.tracking))
